text.autoconfig.cherished-trades.title: Cherished Trades
Shows a bookmark icon next to villager trades, allowing you to mark your favorite trades.
Shows a villager's bookmarked trades above its head when you look at it up close. Bookmarks still work with this off.
Highlights trades selling the enchanted books chosen in the Highlighted Books tab. Turning this off keeps your choices.
Marks enchanted books whose price is among the cheapest a villager can roll, ignoring temporary discounts. Hovering a book also shows its possible price range.

How many of a book's possible prices count as a good deal, starting from the cheapest. At 5%, a book is a good deal about 1 in 20 times a villager offers it, whatever its level. The cheapest price always counts.
Removes every bookmark in the world or server you are playing on. Other worlds and servers keep theirs.
Bookmarks are saved per world or server. Open a world or join a server to clear its bookmarks.
text.autoconfig.cherished-trades.clearBo: Every bookmark in this world or server will be removed. Bookmarks in other worlds and servers are kept. This cannot be undone.
text.autoconfig.cherished-trades.highlig: Turn on the enchanted books you are looking for. Villager trades selling them will be highlighted.
Turns off every book below, including any hidden by the search. Nothing changes until you save.
